ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.7.0 - Out on the water they stand on your ship's deck, and a mother names her own child.
NEW * At sea (War Sails), the talk screen shows them standing on your ship's deck instead of a meadow. On by default now; set EnableSeaStage to false in config.json to keep the meadow. It is still young: if it ever crashes the game, it switches itself off * A mother names her own newborn: the name she spoke of before the birth, or one of her people's, instead of the game picking one * With the Keep Out of Battle mod, companions you keep out of a fight remember watching it, not fighting it
FIXES * Ask someone to research, check or look a thing up and they really search now, instead of pretending to think it over * Out on your ships, people know they are at sea - no more "upon the road" in the middle of the water * The talk screen opens on your wife, or else on the person you've talked with the most * Replies no longer show a stray \n where a paragraph break belongs; old replies that caught it are mended too * Your wedding story (and a child's) reaches your spouse's memory as soon as it's written, not after their next reply * The voice app is found wherever it was installed, even with voices off, and on whichever port it chose * Installing the voice app from the game works with Windows' Smart App Control on, and no longer runs hidden scripts
